The '''2nd Airborne Company''', known simply as the '''2nd Airborne''' or '''2nd Company''', was a [[Clone paratrooper/Legends|clone paratrooper]] [[Company/Legends|company]] that served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[212th Attack Battalion/Legends|212th Attack Battalion]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. 

Led by [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], the 2nd Airborne Company had a distinct disdain for [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]], which they took out on other [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the Grand Army. The 2nd Airborne took part in the [[Battle of Utapau/Legends|Battle of Utapau]], one of the final conflicts of the Clone Wars. 

Following the activation of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], the [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] of the 2nd Airborne Company [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|turned on]] their former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] leader, and later helped overpower the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]] for the newly formed [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Description==
===Overview===
Led by a [[Clone Captain/Legends|clone trooper captain]]<ref name="Leadership" /> and [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], the 2nd Airborne Company, known simply as the 2nd Airborne or 2nd Company, was a [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] [[Company/Legends|company]]<ref name="2005 clone mania">{{SWArchive|url=welcome/about/news/f20051223/index.html|text=''Star Wars:'' The Best of 2005}}</ref> of 144<ref name="Composition" /> [[Clone paratrooper/Legends|clone paratroopers]],<ref name="Sideshow 2ndAC" /> along with support personnel,<ref name="Composition" /> subdivided into four [[Platoon/Legends|platoons]],<ref name="Composition" /> with one of those platoons containing [[Parjai Squad]], a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of paratroopers led by [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|clone trooper sergeant]] [[Barlex]].<ref name="RC:TC" /> 

Falling under the<ref name="Sideshow 2ndAC" /> [[7th Sky Corps/Legends|7th Sky Corps']]<ref name="7th">''[[The Life and Legend of Obi-Wan Kenobi]]''</ref> [[212th Attack Battalion/Legends|212th Attack Battalion]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]]<ref name="Sideshow 2ndAC" /> [[Order of Battle/Legends|Order of Battle]],<ref name="GGAR">{{InsiderCite|84|Guide to the Grand Army of the Republic}}</ref> the 2nd Airborne's [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] specialized in high-altitude drops and airborne operations,<ref name="Sideshow 2ndAC" /> while being trained and programmed for efficient and relentless combat.<ref name="Hasbro Airborne">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars Unleashed|packtype=Battle Pack|pack=Clone Trooper Attack Battalion (Battle of Utapau)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/sw06unlbou-ct.asp}}</ref>

===Equipment and armor===
[[File:Swminiparatrooper.png|thumb|right|250px|The 2nd Airborne's paratroopers wore specialized armor during the war.]]
The 2nd Airborne Company's [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] paratroopers wore specialized, heavy [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II clone trooper armor]] designed to sustain high-altitude drops. The [[Armor/Legends|armor]] was adorned with multiple dual [[Color/Legends|orange]] stripes, designating the [[Trooper/Legends|trooper's]] [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] and affiliation with the company.<ref name="Sideshow 2ndAC" /> Some of the company's troopers wore their armor without any attachments,<ref name="CWCG">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref> although most were equipped with various satchels, pouches, and a gray [[Kama/Legends|kama]].<ref name="SWE3" /> 

Additionally, the 2nd Airborne's troopers wielded [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech]] [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifles]], [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]] [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbines]], [[DC-17 hand blaster/Legends|DC-17 hand blasters]],<ref name="Sideshow 2ndAC" /> and at least one [[E-Web heavy repeating blaster/Legends|E-Web heavy repeating blaster]].<ref name="EGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> For their airborne operations, the 2nd Airborne's troopers wore [[winged jet backpack]]s.<ref name="RC:TC" />

==History==
===The Clone Wars===
Cloned from the [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]],<ref name="Clones">{{DB|organization|clonetroopers|clone troopers}}</ref> and born in [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City's]] cloning facilities on the<ref name="Hasbro Airborne" /> [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]],<ref name="Clones" /> the 2nd Airborne Company's clone paratroopers,<ref name="SWE3" /> along with the company's support personnel,<ref name="Composition" /> participated in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a pan-[[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] war between the Galactic Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="SWE3" />

====Beginning of the war====
[[File:Durge-TCWCG.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Durge stands above the corpse of one of the 2nd Airborne Company's clone troopers.]]
Towards the very beginning of the war, ten of the 2nd Airborne's clone troopers were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Separatist [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]],<ref name="RC:TC" /> leading to the company developping a keen hatred for all Mandalorians. To vent their frustrations towards Mandalorians, the company's members took out their anger on other Mandalorian-trained clones of the Grand Army of the Republic,<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|121|2nd Airborne Company}}</ref> including the [[Special Operations Brigade/Legends|Special Operations Brigade's]] [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]].<ref name="RC:TC" />

At one point during the war, the [[Gen'Dai/Legends|Gen'Dai]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Durge/Legends|Durge]], turned Separatist [[Commander/Legends|commander]], killed one of the 2nd Airborne's clone troopers with a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]], standing above his body on a small rock formation.<ref name="CWCG" /> 

Eventually, one of the 2nd Airborne's [[Squad/Legends|squads]] stormed a Separatist-held world with the 212th Attack Battalion and an [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|All Terrain Tactical Enforcer]] [[Walker/Legends|walker]]. During the conflict, one of the company's paratroopers tended to a trooper of the 212th, while the rest of his squad engaged Separatist forces in a location surrounded by rubble.<ref name="EGtW" />

====Road to Mirial====
{{Quote|Is it the Mando thing that’s coming between us, dear?''"<br />"''Just my appreciation of the irony that we’re fighting Mando mercenaries in some places.|Clone commando Fi and Sergeant Barlex|<ref name="RC:TC" />}}
[[File:Mandalorians_led_by_Boba_Fett.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The 2nd Airborne Company had a unique hatred for Mandalorians (pictured), despite most of its forces being cloned from a Mandalorian's genetic template.]]
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], fifteen [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the start of the war at the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], the 2nd Airborne Company and its Parjai Squad were on board the Republic auxiliary [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Core Conveyor]]'', en-route to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gaftikar]]. Their objective was to drop off the [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] of [[Omega Squad]] and extra supplies for the [[Battle of Gaftikar]] taking place on the planet's surface, which Barlex, the leader of Parjai Squad, believed lowered their chances of survival for their next mission.<ref name="RC:TC" />

During the trip, Barlex and a [[Unidentified loadmaster (2nd Airborne Company)|loadmaster]] of the 2nd Airborne Company expressed their dislike of Mandalorians to the members of Omega Squad, taking out their anger on them, before gearing them up to parajump on Gaftikar. Following the squad's parajump, the 2nd Airborne Company eventually continued to the Outer Rim planet [[Mirial/Legends|Mirial]], to fight the Separatist force stationed there.<ref name="RC:TC" />

====The Battle of Utapau====
{{Quote|Sergeant over here&hellip; Hurry!|A 2nd Airborne Company clone paratrooper during the Battle of Utapau|<ref name="SWE3" />}}
[[File:2ndAC-Utapau.png|thumb|left|300px|The 2nd Airborne Company participated in the Battle of Utapau with the rest of the 7th Sky Corps.]]
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], following the discovery of Separatist [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] on the Outer Rim planet [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]], [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] Obi-Wan Kenobi assembled a fleet of [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] and the [[7th Sky Corps/Legends|7th Sky Corps]] on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], including the 2nd Airborne Company's paratroopers. The assembled force had one goal, to seek out and kill General Grievous in order to end the war. Deploying from Coruscant, the 2nd Airborne headed to Utapau and deployed to the planet's surface on [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]], while General Kenobi engaged Grievous in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]], starting the [[Battle of Utapau/Legends|Battle of Utapau]] against the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] stationed there.<ref name="SWE3" /> 

During the battle, the 2nd Airborne Company's forces faced the Separatist's [[Army/Legends|army]] of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], including<ref name="SWE3" /> [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]], [[OOM-series security droid/Legends|OOM security battle droids]], [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]], [[Octuptarra combat tri-droid/Legends|Octuptarra combat tri-droids]], and [[LM-432 crab droid/Legends|LM-432 crab droids]].<ref name="Battle droids">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> Following his brief duel with Kenobi, General Grievous attempted to escape aboard his personal [[Tsmeu-6 personal wheel bike]], crushing one of the 2nd Airborne's paratroopers in the process, and flinging two more off of a platform afterwards. Later, after the general's death at the hands of Obi-Wan Kenobi, one of the 2nd's troopers signalled to a clone trooper [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] to help a wounded 212th [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]], while more paratroopers were being deployed from a LAAT/i next to them. Immediately afterwards, a 2nd Airborne paratrooper was killed after being shot by a Separatist [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], next to a 212th trooper that was mounting a crab droid to blast it from above.<ref name="SWE3" />

====End of the war====
{{Quote|Did you find Kenobi?''"<br />"''Sir&hellip; No one could have survived that fall.|Commander Cody and a 2nd Airborne trooper|<ref name="SWE3" />}}
[[File:212th-control-Utapau.png|thumb|right|300px|A 2nd Airborne paratrooper reports to Commander Cody after the declaration of Order 66.]]
Towards the end of the battle, [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] executed [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|contingency]] [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], declaring all of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] Jedi traitors of the Republic and ordering their immediate execution. The 2nd Airborne Company's clone troopers,<ref name="SWE3" /> under the forceful influence of an [[Inhibitor chip/Legends|inhibitor chip]] implanted in them at birth,<ref name="Inhibitor chip">{{TCW|Conspiracy}}</ref> turned on their Jedi General. One of the 212th's [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|All Terrain Tactical Enforcers]] turned its [[Mass-driver cannon/Legends|mass-driver cannon]] towards Obi-Wan Kenobi and shot him off of a cliff, sending him and his [[Varactyl/Legends|varactyl]] plummeting into a pool of [[Water/Legends|water]] below.<ref name="SWE3" /> 

Believing the general to have survived, [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|clone marshal commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] of the 212th Attack Battalion ordered one of the 2nd Airborne Company's clones to find the general, to no avail. Upon returning to Cody, the clone was asked if General Kenobi had been found, to which the trooper responded that no one could have survived a fall from that height, as Kenobi escaped the planet aboard Grievous' [[Soulless One/Legends|''Soulless One'']] [[Belbullab-22 starfighter/Legends|Belbullab-22 starfighter]]. Concurrently, the 2nd Airborne Company assisted the [[41st Stormtrooper Legion|41st Elite Legion]] and the 212th Attack Battalion in the subjugation of the planet's [[Pau'an/Legends|Pau'an]] population.<ref name="SWE3" />

===Rise of the Galactic Empire===
{{Quote|Sergeant Barlex, Second Airborne, Two-hundred-and-twelfth Battalion. Remember him? Miserable di’kut. He called us born-again Mandos, and his loadmaster said they’d been up against Mandos fighting for the Seps[&hellip;]|Niner, to Darman, after the events of Order 66|<ref name="RC:501st">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Occupation-of-Utapau.png|thumb|left|300px|The 2nd Airborne Company helped subjugate Utapau for the Galactic Empire.]]
Following the [[Declaration of a New Order|rise]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in 19 BBY, the clone paratroopers of the 2nd Airborne Company were reorganized as [[clone stormtrooper]]s, and began serving under the new [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]], continuing to overthrow Utapau for the Imperial regime.<ref name="Sideshow 2ndAC" /> 

Later in the same year, after a meeting with the new commander of the [[Imperial Commando Special Unit]], a unit of special forces clone troopers tasked with eliminating Jedi, clone commando [[Niner Skirata|Niner]] mentioned the 2nd Airborne Company to commando [[Darman Skirata|Darman]], while reminiscing about Sergeant Barlex in an effort to rekindle his relationship with him.<ref name="RC:501st" />

==Behind the scenes==
The 2nd Airborne Company first appeared, albeit unnamed, in {{Film|III}}, a [[2005]] film written and directed by [[George Lucas]].<ref name="SWE3" /> The company was later named in a ''[[Star Wars Blog]]'' post by author [[Karen Traviss]], posted after the film's release, in the same year. The 2nd Airborne Company was named by Karen Traviss as an homage to the real-world paratroopers of the [[Wikipedia:2nd Battalion, Parachute Regiment|2nd Battalion Parachute Regiment]] of the [[Wikipedia:British Army|British Army]].<ref name="WTC">{{Blog|karentraviss|42|Who was that clone?|nobackup=1}}</ref> Due to the 2nd Airborne Company's tactics in ''Revenge of the Sith'', and its appearance on the cover of [[Star Wars Insider 84|''Star Wars Insider'' 84]], an intense fan-demand for more information on clone paratroopers emerged in the year 2005.<ref name="Clone Mania">{{SWArchive|url=welcome/about/news/f20051223/index.html|text=''Star Wars:'' The Best of 2005}}</ref>
